instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Retail bank operating 45 branches across northern Portugal serving 180,000 individual and 12,000 business customers. Core product portfolio includes mortgages, consumer loans, current accounts, and SME lending. Currently executing a digital transformation roadmap including mobile-first account opening and AI-assisted credit adjudication. We have a dedicated management team across core functions but operate with limited middle management layers. Budget cycles are annual with moderate flexibility for mid-year reallocation if a strong business case is presented. Innovation initiatives compete with day-to-day operational demands for team attention.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.

fields.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 6 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Proactive Digital Retention Program (Post-Onboarding Care)
opportunities.rationale: The prior efforts successfully improved initial customer acquisition speed. To achieve 'market defense,' the focus must now shift to strengthening switching costs and maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV). This initiative uses digital channels to provide value post-onboarding, making it harder for competitors to lure customers away.

first_actions: Map out customer journey touchpoints 30, 90, and 180 days after onboarding, prioritizing regulatory compliance checks at each stage.
Develop targeted educational content (e.g., managing investment products, utilizing SME services) delivered via mobile app to increase usage depth.
Integrate AI-driven health scoring into the core banking system to flag customers exhibiting low engagement risk.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in 90-day churn rate by X% and increase in average products held per customer.
milestones: Completion of customer journey mapping and compliance review (Month 1).
Pilot launch of the first retention module with a limited segment of high-risk customers (Month 3).

opportunities.title: Automated Compliance Risk Profiling Tool Integration
opportunities.rationale: Facing highly regulated market competition, reducing operational risk and improving efficiency is paramount. Integrating a centralized tool to profile compliance risks (KYC, AML) at the point of interaction will not only enhance regulatory adherence but also speed up complex lending decisions, matching competitor digital experiences.

first_actions: Consult with Legal and Compliance teams to define mandatory data inputs and acceptable risk thresholds for automation (Regulatory Focus).
Scope the integration point: determining if this tool overlays existing core banking systems or requires a dedicated middleware layer.
Develop standardized workflows for human review when automated profiling flags an exception.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average time taken to process a high-risk loan application by Y%, while maintaining zero compliance breaches.
milestones: Definition and sign-off on risk parameters with Compliance (Month 1.5).
Successful sandboxed integration test of the profiling tool.

next_steps.action: Formalize and implement cross-functional training modules for middle management layers to distribute operational knowledge and reduce single points of failure.

Establish a formal, quarterly strategic review process involving senior leaders to prioritize innovation initiatives and allocate specific 'innovation budget' funds, mitigating competition with day-to-day demands.
Develop clear internal metrics (e.g., cost per digital interaction, time saved by process automation) to create a powerful business case for increased budget allocation.

key_weaknesses: Limited middle management layer capacity, risking dependency on senior leadership.
Decision-making process remains concentrated with the owner, slowing scale and adaptation.
Innovation initiatives still struggle to compete effectively for resources against immediate operational demands.

improvements: Successfully formalized digital onboarding flow, significantly reducing customer friction (12 days to 5 days).
Structural improvements achieved through the hiring of 6 senior leaders and the formalization of strategic planning processes.
Increased capacity for cross-functional execution involving Product, Compliance, and Customer Success.
persistent_gaps: Operational bottlenecks remain due to limited middle management scalability.
The company still lacks a formalized mechanism for sustained budget protection for mid-term strategic projects.
Dependence on the founder/owner's direct decision input, which limits agility.
achieved_milestones: Digital onboarding flow launched and measured (NPS +22 points).
Dedicated senior management team established across core functions.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant structural maturation observed (hiring senior leaders, formalizing strategy). While process efficiency improved greatly via the onboarding flow, key systemic barriers like middle management capacity and decentralized decision-making remain challenges.
